_comment: Configuration values for the CoreDNS managed add-on (hub/04 L200 s2.2, L300 s2.6). Apply with: aws eks update-addon --cluster-name shopfront-dev --addon-name coredns --configuration-values file://labs/eks/addons/coredns-configuration-values.json --resolve-conflicts PRESERVE. Add-on autoscaling replaces the cluster-proportional-autoscaler: EKS scales the Deployment between minReplicas and maxReplicas on node and core counts. The Corefile keeps the default plugins; `cache 30` and `prefer_udp` on the forward plugin cut the tail latency that ndots:5 causes; `log . { class error }` records failures without logging every query.
